Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:
Quick question...

inferior Revelation of Wrath says: "Only usable at the end of a round
in which the opposing minion inflicted more than 1 damage or any
aggravated damage (even if the damage is prevented)..."

while superior RoW says: "As above, and place an additional corruption
counter if the opposing minion inflicted more than 2 damage or more
than 1 aggravated damage this round."

There's no "(even if the damage is prevented)" in the superior text, so
does that mean you can only add an additional corruption counter if
your minion actually takes more than 2 damage or more than 1 agg? Or
is the parenthetical carried over from the inferior?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


"As above" carries it over.

Thanks. I was afraid that "as above" would cause it to be read like
this: "Only usable when an opposing minion inflicted more than 1
damage, etc. (even if prevented)... and place an additional counter if
the opposing minion *successfully* inflicted more than 2 damage,
etc..." Since inflicted, by default, means successfully inflicted.

But I'd much rather interpret it your way (i.e. the correct way).
